Former paramedic. 25 years in prenatal chiropractic. Evidence-based. Trauma-informed. Designed for chiropractors ready to close the gap between routine care and specialized competence.
The Bloom Intensive: modular online mentoring in communication, safety, knowledge, and biomechanical care for pregnant patients.
Real training. Real outcomes.
Enroll in The Bloom Intensive: A 12 week intensive cohort to bridge the gap.
